root_cause: PR added test_image_format_against_real_docker_for_all_label_shapes with a module-level @pytest.mark.skipif(_docker_daemon() is None). _docker_daemon() runs `docker version` at import time. test_deploy_nonprod_artifact_restore's original-chain tests import test_dev_release_artifacts while a recording stub docker is on PATH, so the probe was recorded as an UNEXPECTED_docker event and the exact-events assertion failed (2 tests in Persona provisioning owner contracts). Deterministic; reproduced locally; dev passes.
fix: Probe Docker lazily inside the test body (pytest.skip) instead of at import time. Applied on the PR branch task/DEV-STACK-CAPTURE-UNLABELED-20261106.
